Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Capable of giving signed informed consent.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has provided written informed consent, satisfying this criterion.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Male or female participants ≥ 18 years of age at the time of screening.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is a 53-year-old female, meeting the age requirement.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Negative serum pregnancy test at screening and negative serum or urine pregnancy test every 3 months during the treatment period (women of childbearing potential only).
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about pregnancy test results.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Pathologically confirmed tumor that is metastatic, advanced, or recurrent with progression for which no alternative known to improve survival or curative therapy exists. Tumors must be TMB-H or Strata Immune Signature positive.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has metastatic non-small cell lung cancer, but there is no information on TMB-H or Strata Immune Signature status.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Must have at least 1 measurable lesion per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) 1.1. The measurable lesion must be outside of a radiation field if the participant received prior radiation.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the presence of measurable lesions or prior radiation treatment.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status score of 0 or 1.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's ECOG performance status is not mentioned in the provided data.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Prior chemotherapy or certain immune therapies or biologic agents must have been completed at least 4 weeks (28 days) before investigational product administration and all AEs have either returned to baseline or stabilized.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information on the timing of prior chemotherapy or the status of adverse events.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Previously treated brain or meningeal metastases with no evidence of progression by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) for at least 4 weeks (28 days) prior to the first dose.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no mention of brain or meningeal metastases, so this criterion is irrelevant.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Immunosuppressive doses of systemic medications, such as corticosteroids or absorbed topical corticosteroids (doses > 10 mg/day prednisone or equivalent) must be discontinued at least 2 weeks (14 days) before investigational product administration. Physiologic doses of corticosteroids < 10 mg/day of prednisone or its equivalent may be permitted.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information on the use of corticosteroids or their dosages.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Prior surgery that required general anesthesia or other major surgery as defined by the Investigator must be completed at least 4 weeks before investigational product administration.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information on any prior surgeries the patient may have had.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Negative tests for hepatitis B surface antigen, hepatitis C virus antibody (or hepatitis C qualitative ribonucleic acid [RNA; qualitative]), and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)-1 and HIV-2 antibody at screening.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about hepatitis or HIV test results.
There is no specific information on organ or marrow function provided in the patient data.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Use of any live attenuated vaccines against infectious diseases within 4 weeks (28 days) of initiation of investigational product.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information on recent vaccinations.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Underlying medical conditions that, in the Investigator's or Sponsor's opinion, will make the administration of investigational product hazardous or obscure the interpretation of toxicity determination or Adverse events (AEs).
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information on underlying medical conditions that could affect the trial.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: History of myocardial infarction within 6 months or history of arterial thromboembolic event within 3 months of the first dose of investigational agent.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no mention of a history of myocardial infarction or arterial thromboembolic events.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has known psychiatric or substance abuse disorders that would interfere with cooperation with the requirements of the trial.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no mention of psychiatric or substance abuse disorders.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Is pregnant or breastfeeding or expecting to conceive or father children within the projected duration of the study, starting with the pre-screening or screening visit through 90 days after the last dose of investigational product.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information on pregnancy or breastfeeding status.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Any active or documented history of autoimmune disease or history of a syndrome that required systemic steroids or immunosuppressive medications.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no mention of autoimmune diseases or history of systemic steroid use.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Any acute gastrointestinal symptoms at the time of screening or admission.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no mention of acute gastrointestinal symptoms.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Prior malignancy active within the previous year except for locally curable cancers that have been apparently cured.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's lung cancer is not described as active within the previous year, and there is no mention of other active malignancies.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Prior treatment with an anti-PD-L1 or anti-PD-1 as monotherapy or in combination.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is currently on osimertinib, not an anti-PD-L1 or anti-PD-1 therapy.
There is no mention of prior treatment with temozolomide.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Use of other investigational drugs (drugs not marketed for any indication) within 28 days or at least 5 half-lives (whichever is longer) before investigational product administration.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no mention of the use of other investigational drugs.

Recap: The patient meets the inclusion criteria for age, consent, and lack of brain metastases. However, there is insufficient information to determine eligibility regarding pregnancy tests, tumor biomarkers, measurable lesions, ECOG status, prior chemotherapy, corticosteroid use, surgeries, hepatitis/HIV tests, and organ function. Exclusion criteria are not violated based on available data, but there is insufficient information on vaccinations, underlying medical conditions, and pregnancy status.
